name: itsbgra
positioning: A DJ learning in public who turns every blend that works into a recipe beginners can copy — and save in Mixnote.

hookFormulas: If you're a beginner DJ, steal this {bars}-bar blend
{Song A} → {Song B}: the blend that finally clicked
I practised this {technique} all week — here's the recipe
The {technique} mistake I kept making (and the fix)
ctas: The full recipe is in Mixnote
Which blend should I learn next?

do: Frame 0 is you: your face, or you at the decks, filling the 9:16 frame
Shoot vertical: a phone above the decks plus one front angle; never letterbox landscape footage
Name the blend in the hook text: "Song A → Song B", and speak to beginners ("If you're a beginner DJ…")
Hook in the first 4 s, then let the blend play in long takes (8–24 s)
Show the recipe card once the blend lands: technique · bars, BPM · key
Master to about −14 LUFS; photo posts use the official track sound
dont: No blue/violet LED room as the look
No copied templates (a purple title box with a "DJ Mix Tutorial" pill)
No "Day N" numbering as the hook
No voice-over needed: on-screen text carries the teaching
Never quieter than the references: −20 LUFS or lower reads as broken

summary: Recipe cards are your top 2 posts: 633 and 208 likes vs a median of 11 for your videos
About 30 of 37 reference thumbnails show a person; 0 of your 11 do
Your videos: luma 33 and −31 LUFS vs references' 97 and −16.8 (letterboxed and quiet)
References' top half cut first at 3.7 s (vs 5.0 s) and then hold 24 s shots (vs 16.5 s)
6 of @offtherackjack's top 8 open by naming the beginner

direction.label: Sunset Booth
direction.summary: Wine-dark ground, Mixnote's orange-to-magenta, rounded type, stroked captions.
direction.rationale: The person: a friend on the journey (warmth 0.65, playfulness 0.5) using the colours of Mixnote's own icon, orange into magenta, on a wine-dark ground. Rounded friendly type and stroked caps make the text-led teaching feel like a mate's notes, and the edits are punchier.

sting.description: a 1 s French-house filter open on a disco chord with a crowd 'woo'

sfx.pop: bubbly pop for each caption group

voice.style: no voice-over; on-screen text carries the teaching

samples.hook: I learned this blend in a week. You can too.
samples.caption: first transition I was proud of
